name: task-toast
title: Task toast
description: One toast that follows a task from start to finish: a spinner, a live progress bar, then success, or a failure with Retry, all in the same toast.
docs: const task = taskToast({ title: 'Exporting orders', onCancel }); then task.progress(0.4, '1,200 of 3,000 orders'), task.success('Export ready', { action }) or task.error('Export failed', { onRetry }). It is one toast the whole way and changes in place: a spinner, a slim bar with a percentage, a check that closes itself after five seconds, or a warning that stays until it is dealt with. If someone closes the toast by hand while the task runs, the result still arrives as a toast; task.dismiss() closes it for good. taskToast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error }) covers a task with no progress to report. Mount Toaster once, as for any toast. The Toaster shows the last three toasts, so a fourth can push out an error toast together with its Retry: for a long job, keep Retry reachable elsewhere as well.
